fallback.note: the hybrid decision depends on an unhashed-in-code cache; these sha256 values bind the fallback source into the result and into each receipt's fallback.source_sha256

paired_clip_bootstrap.note: paired clip-grouped bootstrap, 2,000 shared resamples, seed 0; AUROC delta = rules - ensemble (both higher=bad), BA delta = hybrid - pure(review-as-accept)

gold_loco.per_window_scores_note: one row per gold window: id, clip, y, score, decision, p_ens, hybrid_decision; every metric above is re-derivable from these rows

leakage.candidate_rule_list_and_signs: tools/phys/rules.json is the Q1 rule table; its candidate rules, features and signs were chosen by the author with all 150 IndEgo labels visible, so the gold LOCO AUROC is an OPTIMISTIC in-domain estimate (see the Q1 report). Fold thresholds are nested.
leakage.in_sample_deployment_table: the shipped rules.json is derived from all 7 clips and its in-sample AUROC (0.8239) is not a held-out number
leakage.significance: paired group-bootstrap CIs on the differences are reported below; treat differences whose CI contains 0 as not established

paired_factory_bootstrap.note: paired factory-grouped bootstrap, 2,000 shared resamples, seed 0; AUROC delta = rules - ensemble (both higher=bad), BA delta = hybrid - pure(review-as-accept)

ood160.per_window_scores_note: one row per OOD window: id, factory, y, score, decision, usable_prob, hybrid_decision
ood160.protocol: frozen IndEgo rule table applied read-only; no OOD fitting. Factory-grouped bootstrap CI (n_boot=2000, seed=0) is the honest CI.
